newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq's information minister replaced - INA.
newsitem.headline: Iraq's information minister replaced - INA.

text.p: Iraqi Culture and Information Minister Abd-al-Ghani Abd-al-Ghafur has been relieved of his post, the official Iraqi News Agency (INA) said on Thursday.
He was replaced by presidential adviser Hamed Youssef Hummadi, it said.
"Culture and Information Minister Abd-al-Ghani Abd-al-Ghafur is relieved from his post," said INA, quoting a presidential decree signed by President Saddam Hussein on Wednesday.
"Hamed Youssef Hummadi is appointed Minister of Culture and Information," another decree said.
Hummadi had been information minister before -- from 1991 until January 1996 when he was replaced by Abd-al-Ghafur, who is also a senior member of the ruling Baath Party's Regional Command.
There was no immediate explanation for the change.
